purpose: Phase-7C immune-microenvironment context profiles per species + tumour model. Each profile names the immune domains that context SUPPORTS and its baseline immune posture. The frozen package has NO direct immune dataset for this tripterine-NLC context (Chen 2012 measured antimelanoma RESPONSE, not immune infiltration / checkpoint / cytotoxicity), so every active profile is a LABELLED prediction (general tumour-immunology biology) or NOT_REPORTED - never experimental. Species/model/formulation are strictly isolated; no silent transfer. NOTE (Part 1 - Section 1): this section establishes CONTRACTS only; the immune biology is populated in later sections, so a resolved profile still yields UNAVAILABLE component outputs (structurally valid, explicitly labelled) until then. No immune-cell count / expression level / cytokine concentration is stated (all NOT_REPORTED).

mouse_b16bl6_immune.uncertainty: B16BL6 melanoma is generally regarded as poorly immunogenic / immunosuppressive; this posture is inferred from general tumour-immunology biology, not measured for this tripterine-NLC context. All immune values schematic; Section 1 exposes them as UNAVAILABLE (biology pending later sections).
mouse_b16bl6_immune.limitations: No immune-cell count / checkpoint expression / cytokine level / cytotoxic rate (all NOT_REPORTED). Not a clinical immunotherapy predictor.

human_skin_immune.uncertainty: A PREDICTIVE, exploratory human immune microenvironment with its OWN distinct posture - NOT copied from mouse. Not validated for human clinical immune response; abstract only.
human_skin_immune.human_translation_warning: This immune microenvironment is a mechanistic, exploratory prediction and is not validated for human clinical immune response, immunotherapy, or outcome.
human_skin_immune.limitations: Predictive only; no human immune measurement; all values schematic (NOT_REPORTED quantitatively).

rat_skin_immune.uncertainty: Rat data support skin permeation only; no rat tumour immune dataset. No immune microenvironment is generated from skin-permeation evidence alone.
rat_skin_immune.reason: no rat tumour immune evidence -> NOT_REPORTED

context_rules.read_only_upstream: Phase 7C reads validated tumour / apoptosis / Phase-7A microenvironment / Phase-7B vascular outputs READ-ONLY; it mutates nothing upstream.
context_rules.publishes_immutable_output: Phase 7C publishes a versioned immutable ImmuneFrame; Phase 8A consumes it READ-ONLY and mutates nothing here.
context_rules.species_isolation: Mouse / human / rat immune profiles are strictly isolated; a cross-species use requires a CROSS_SPECIES_PREDICTION.
context_rules.no_experimental_tier: Immune relationships are labelled predictions; there is no experimental immune tier for this context.
context_rules.not_reported_stays: Rat stays NOT_REPORTED; human is a labelled predictive-exploratory mode.
context_rules.section1_foundational: Section 1 establishes contracts; component outputs are UNAVAILABLE until later sections populate the biology.
